answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 43224 Country: India Title: What should we do with the old and unused Quran and Islamic books Question: What should we do with the old and unused Quran and Islamic books? Answer ID: 43224 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 152/152/M=1434) Unusable and timeworn copies of the Quran or other Islamic books should be wrapped in neat and clean clothes and buried underneath the earth in a place where there is no fear of desecration. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
